patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,10 +1,38 @@
-class Robot:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    @property
-    def name(self) -> str:
-        pass
-
-    def reset(self) -> None:
-        pass
+class Robot:
+    _counter = 0
+    _used_names = set()
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._name = None
+        self._generate_name()
+
+    @property
+    def name(self) -> str:
+        return self._name
+
+    def reset(self) -> None:
+        if self._name:
+            Robot._used_names.discard(self._name)
+        self._generate_name()
+
+    def _generate_name(self) -> None:
+        while True:
+            if Robot._counter >= 676000:
+                raise RuntimeError("Exhausted all possible robot names")
+            
+            part1 = Robot._counter // 1000
+            part2 = Robot._counter % 1000
+            
+            first_letter = part1 // 26
+            second_letter = part1 % 26
+            
+            letters = chr(65 + first_letter) + chr(65 + second_letter)
+            digits = str(part2).zfill(3)
+            new_name = letters + digits
+            
+            Robot._counter += 1
+            
+            if new_name not in Robot._used_names:
+                Robot._used_names.add(new_name)
+                self._name = new_name
+                break
